style_image.usage_description: OWN original headless body cropped only as a palette, outline and shading sample. Draw a NEW BALD HEAD only. Do not draw or imitate the torso shapes.

description: Original Project Shaman modular BALD HUMAN HEAD only, FRONT facing camera at classic elevated MMORPG overhead three-quarter perspective, isolated skull, face, two ears and chin. Absolutely NO HAIR, NO NECK, NO TORSO, NO SHOULDERS, NO CLOTHES, NO HAT. Warm tan youthful male face, large readable dark brown eyes, calm neutral expression, softly rounded tapered jaw, compact chibi fantasy proportions, subtle small nose and mouth. Actual head including ears should be about24 pixels wide and24 pixels tall, centered on32 canvas with chin near y28. Crisp native one-pixel clusters, thin dark warm brown outline, 5 warm tan/peach skin tones matching OWN body style sample; subtle upper-left highlight, restrained shadows. Consistent scale for compact ~3 head tall body. Transparent around entire head. No background, no floor shadow, no extra heads or details. Entirely new head artwork, not traced or cropped from any complete character.
